# Prompt

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Prompt>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A concrete prompt presented to a model in an invocation — content-addressable ([`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md)), role-tagged ([`gmeow:promptRole`](../properties/gmeow-promptRole.md)), optionally instantiating a template ([`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md)). Prompts are provenance: a claim is only auditable when the instruction that elicited it is recorded. The system-prompt-as-persona seam (a prompt enacting a [`gmeow:Persona`](gmeow-Persona.md) with its registers and style guide) is the norms extension's machinery, used from instance data.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the concrete instruction text presented to a model in an invocation — the provenance that makes a generated claim auditable, content-addressed and role-tagged.

### Avoid when

- Avoid the reusable, variable-bearing artifact (that is [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md), which a concrete prompt links back to via [`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md)) and avoid modelling the persona it enacts here — that seam lives in the norms extension.

### How to use

- Type the instruction [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md), tag it with [`gmeow:promptRole`](../properties/gmeow-promptRole.md), content-address it with [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md), and where it instantiates a published template point [`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md) at the [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md); link it to its invocation via [`gmeow:hasPrompt`](../properties/gmeow-hasPrompt.md).

### Examples

- ex:sysPrompt a [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md); [`gmeow:promptRole`](../properties/gmeow-promptRole.md) [`gmeow:promptRoleSystem`](../individuals/gmeow-promptRoleSystem.md); [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md) ex:sha256.
